## Native geometry experiment
Original GLB required EXT_texture_webp; actual VTK import failed metadata loading. Re-encoded both embedded WebP texture images losslessly as PNG from decoded pixels, replaced image bufferViews and texture source descriptors, removed now-unused extension requirements. Actual VTK import succeeded. Appended PNG buffers without stripping original bytes (not a mobile size optimization). Preserve all 219071 vertices and 192765 triangles, UVs, indices and material. Original bounds x[-.453962,.003706], y[-.226072,.249022], z[-.234040,.466093]. Source front +Z, rear -Z, up +Y.

Test two posterior compression strengths and a corrected monotone alternative; protect upper head and anterior feet. Define S(t)=clamp(t,0,1)^2*(3-2*clamp(t,0,1)). First parameterization w=S((.17-z)/.36)*S((.14-y)/.36), z'=z+k*w*(.14-z), y'=y+.12*k*w, k=.45/.75. Corrected warp d=max(.24-z,0), w=S((.17-y)/.40), z'=z+.70*w*d*d/(d+.09), y'=y+.035*S(d/.35)*w. x unchanged. For each use central difference Jacobian J with eps=1e-4, transform normals by inverse transpose, normalize, replace original position/normal buffers, update position bounds, export genuine GLB. Determinants sampled at all vertices; positive sampled determinant is not proof of global absence of self intersection.
